messages:
Mei: Quick usability pass on the console: empty table + pagination is pushing the footer offscreen at narrow widths (<480px). Screenshot attached.
Arjun: Seen it. The empty card is too tall (large top padding) and the full pagination controls are overkill on mobile.
Priya: Suggestion: collapse pagination to Prev / Next on small widths and hide numeric pages behind a menu. Keeps CTA visible.
Mei: Also the empty card uses spacing-20 which feels huge on phone. Can we map card padding to responsive tokens instead of hard pixels?
Arjun: Prefer not to create one-off tokens. Proposal: introduce `card-padding` responsive token that resolves to spacing-20 desktop, spacing-12 tablet, spacing-06 mobile. Add a platform alias so devs find it.
Priya: A11y: when numeric pages are hidden, ensure overflow menu exposes current page ("Page 2 of 8") and set aria-current on the active item. Screen readers should still be able to jump.
Mei: Copy tweak for empty state: change "No results found. Try widening your filter." -> "No runs match these filters. Try removing a filter or widening the date range." Shorter and action-focused.
Sam: Approved. Also add a tiny inline help link "Why no results?" that opens a tooltip with common causes so we keep the card compact.
Arjun: Implementation: move pagination into the empty card when there are zero rows. For populated tables keep a sticky condensed footer. Footer must not exceed token `footer-height` (48px). If pagination needs more space, switch to condensed mode (icon-only prev/next).
Priya: Condensed mode needs 44x44 hit targets for touch and accessible labels for icon buttons. Use token alias `control-hit` mapped to spacing-10 so spacing stays consistent.
DesignBot: Note: there is an existing pattern `responsive-token` for card paddings. Create `card-padding` as an instance to keep consistency.
Mei: I'll drop mockups + a short mobile GIF by EOD.
Arjun: I'll open a PR with CSS, token mappings, and screenshots for 360/480/1024 breakpoints.
Priya: I'll run NVDA/VoiceOver + keyboard checks once PR is up and run Lighthouse for contrast and focus order.
Sam: Owners: Mei (visuals + copy), Arjun (PR + tokens), Priya (a11y). Ping here when staging link is ready. :thumbsup:
DesignBot: New issue created: #4882 - "Responsive empty state + condensed pagination". Labels: design, a11y, tokens, release-mvp.
Arjun: Will aim for a canary build tomorrow.
Mei: Thanks team!
